title.en: Cancel a queued Morpho Vault V2 cap increase (curator or sentinel)
title.zh-TW: 取消排隊中的 Morpho Vault V2 上限提高（curator 或 sentinel）

summary.en: The Safe calls the vault's `multicall` with two `revoke` calls inside: they cancel the absolute and relative cap increases queued earlier with `submit` and not yet executed. After the cancel, `executableAt` goes back to zero and those two calls can no longer run. It moves none of the Safe's assets.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 vault 的 `multicall`，裡面兩個 `revoke`：取消之前 `submit` 排隊、還沒執行的絕對上限和相對上限提高。取消後 `executableAt` 歸零，那兩個呼叫不能再執行。不動 Safe 的任何資產。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 spreads deposits across several Morpho Blue markets. The curator sets how much each market can hold (its cap), and the allocator moves funds within the caps. Raising a cap takes a `submit` first, and it can run only after the timelock has passed.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 把存款分配到多個 Morpho Blue 市場。curator 設定每個市場能放多少（上限），allocator 在上限內搬錢。提高上限要先 `submit`，等 timelock 過了才能執行。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 10 audits (Spearbit, Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity, Certora and one contest).
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 10 份稽核（Spearbit、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity、Certora 和一場競賽）。

text.en: The data `revoke` takes must be exactly the same as in the original `submit`, cap numbers included; otherwise the vault reverts (there is no queued data for it). Only the curator or a sentinel can cancel.
text.zh-TW: `revoke` 要的資料必須跟當初 `submit` 的一模一樣，包括上限數字；不一樣的話 vault 會 revert（沒有排隊的資料）。只有 curator 或 sentinel 能取消。

recommendation.en: Fill in the market and both caps from the queued one. verify confirms that both `executableAt` values go down.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照排隊中的那筆填市場和兩個上限；verify 確認兩個 `executableAt` 都減少。

text.en: AI has no browser that runs JavaScript, so it did not open the market's page on the Morpho app. AI read Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` on chain (market id 0x64d65c9a2d91c36d56fbc42d69e979335320169b3df63bf92789e2c8883fcc64), and the oracle it answers is 0xA6D6950c9F177F1De7f7757FB33539e3Ec60182a. The market id is the hash of the five parameters, so a different oracle means a different market.
text.zh-TW: AI 沒有能跑 JavaScript 的瀏覽器，沒打開 Morpho app 的市場頁。AI 在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`（市場 id 0x64d65c9a2d91c36d56fbc42d69e979335320169b3df63bf92789e2c8883fcc64），回答的 oracle 就是 0xA6D6950c9F177F1De7f7757FB33539e3Ec60182a；市場 id 是五個參數的 hash，換掉 oracle 就是另一個市場。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. To check again, open this market's page on the Morpho app and compare the oracle address.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；想再確認就在 Morpho app 打開這個市場頁比對 oracle 地址。

text.en: AI read Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` on chain: for both markets, usdc-usp-915 and usdc-usp-86, the oracle it answers is 0x5096642B7c7CD82198932f3FADd873EC2fcDeb6d. The market id is the hash of the five parameters, so a different oracle means a different market.
text.zh-TW: AI 在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`：usdc-usp-915 和 usdc-usp-86 兩個市場回答的 oracle 都是 0x5096642B7c7CD82198932f3FADd873EC2fcDeb6d；市場 id 是五個參數的 hash，換掉 oracle 就是另一個市場。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. To check again, open these two markets' pages on the Morpho app and compare the oracle address.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；想再確認就在 Morpho app 打開這兩個市場頁比對 oracle 地址。

role.en: The vault's asset, also the token the markets lend
role.zh-TW: vault 的資產，也是市場借出的代幣

role.en: Morpho Blue itself; the markets live inside it
role.zh-TW: Morpho Blue 本體，市場在它裡面

role.en: The oracle the market uses to price cbBTC
role.zh-TW: 市場用來給 cbBTC 定價的 oracle

role.en: The factory that creates Vault V2 market adapters. It answers `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true: it created the adapter
role.zh-TW: 建立 Vault V2 市場轉接合約的工廠，它回答 `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true，轉接合約是它建立的

role.en: The collateral token of the USP markets
The oracle the USP markets use to price USP
role.zh-TW: USP 市場用來給 USP 定價的 oracle

1.multicall.data.en: The two calls the vault runs in order, fixed at two items: cancel the absolute cap first, then the relative cap. If either fails, the whole transaction fails.
1.multicall.data.zh-TW: vault 依序執行的兩個呼叫，固定兩項：先取消絕對上限，再取消相對上限。任一個失敗，整筆失敗。

1.multicall.data[0].en: Item 1: cancel the queued absolute cap increase.
1.multicall.data[0].zh-TW: 第一項：取消排隊中的絕對上限提高。

1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.en: The full call to cancel, which must be exactly as it was queued, listed item by item below.
1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.zh-TW: 要取消的完整呼叫，必須跟排隊時一模一樣，下面逐項列出。

1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "this market in this adapter".
1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「這個轉接合約裡的這個市場」。

1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.en: The kind of id, fixed to this/marketParams: a cap on one market, not on the whole adapter or on a collateral token.
1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this/marketParams：單一市場的上限，不是整個轉接合約或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets.
1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場。

1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.en: The market's five parameters, which together are the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，合起來就是你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.en: The queued absolute cap number. Typing `max` means what was queued was no absolute cap.
1.multicall.data[0].revoke.data.increase.zh-TW: 排隊中的絕對上限數字，打 `max` 等於當初排的是不設絕對上限。

1.multicall.data[1].en: Item 2: cancel the queued relative cap increase.
1.multicall.data[1].zh-TW: 第二項：取消排隊中的相對上限提高。

1.multicall.data[1].revoke.data.en: The full call to cancel, which must be exactly as it was queued, listed item by item below.
1.multicall.data[1].revoke.data.zh-TW: 要取消的完整呼叫，必須跟排隊時一模一樣，下面逐項列出。

1.multicall.data[1].revoke.data.increase.en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "this market in this adapter".

1.multicall.data[1].revoke.data.increase.en: The kind of id, fixed to this/marketParams: a cap on one market, not on the whole adapter or on a collateral token.
1.multicall.data[1].revoke.data.increase.zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this/marketParams：單一市場的上限，不是整個轉接合約或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[1].revoke.data.increase.zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場。
